messages:
Ava (People Ops): Heads up — we've published an update to the Employee Handbook under 'Remote Work & Compliance' and assigned the accompanying annual compliance training. Please read the short policy summary and complete the training by May 14. Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/handbook/remote-work-compliance :point_right: training assigned via LMS (see below).

Jonas R.: Thanks Ava — quick q: does this apply to contractors and external temps?

Ava (People Ops): Yes — contractors who are on payroll or on a long-term SOW (30+ days) must complete the module. Short-term consultants are exempt unless they handle customer data. We added a note in the handbook section.

Priya S.: Is there any flexibility on the May 14 deadline for teams in APAC? Their week runs differently.

Ava (People Ops): We can allow a 1-week extension for APAC teams — managers should file a People Ops ticket (hr.redwood/ticket) with the team list and justification. We need tracked approval for audit purposes.

Allison (Legal): FYI — for compliance audits we need a copy of completions (user, module, completion timestamp). People Ops, please export and store to our compliance bucket after the deadline.

LMS Bot: automated message: Module assigned: "Remote Work & Data Handling (2026)" to 214 users. Due: 1719757200 (May 14 2026). Progress: 0% completed. Link to module: https://lms.redwood.internal/course/remote-data-2026

Marco (Engineering Manager): I'll ping my eng leads today and set reminders in Team Standups. Can you drop a tracking sheet with manager view?

Ava (People Ops): Yep — created a read/write tracking sheet (edit access for managers): https://sheets.redwood.internal/handbook-compliance-2026. Please add your people (email or internal id) and update status: assigned/in-progress/completed. Quick CSV header you can paste:

```
manager,employee_internal_id,employee_email,status,completed_at,notes
```

Jonas R.: For the people who already completed a similar module last Q4, do they need to redo?

Ava (People Ops): If completed in the last 12 months and module name matches, they are exempt — please mark them 'completed' with the previous completion date and attach the certificate link in notes. We'll validate exports against LMS records.

Priya S.: Will this change any of the remote-eligibility rules (like core overlap hours)?

Ava (People Ops): No change to remote-eligibility or core overlap. This update clarifies expectations around data handling when working remotely and documents the escalation path for incidents.

Allison (Legal): Also adding: managers should keep a copy of team completion statuses for 2 years for audit readiness. People Ops will keep the master export as well.

Marco (Engineering Manager): Noted. I'll ask leads to update the sheet by EOD Monday.

Ava (People Ops): Thanks — I'll run a follow-up report on Tuesday and send a reminder to anyone still outstanding. If you need bulk extensions or an exemption list, ping me directly. :thumbsup:

LMS Bot: reminder scheduled: auto-reminder #1 to assigned users in 72 hours.

Jonas R.: Thanks — appreciate the clarity.

Ava (People Ops): Closing the loop here — policy link one more time: https://redwood.internal/docs/handbook/remote-work-compliance. Reach out if anything unclear.
